scripts.build:local: pnpm run prisma:generate && rm -rf ./.next && next build
scripts.build:analyze: pnpm run node:validate && cross-env ANALYZE_BUNDLE=true next build --webpack
scripts.lint: pnpm run eslint && pnpm run prettier
scripts.lint:errors: pnpm exec eslint --quiet --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern . && pnpm run prettier
scripts.format: pnpm run prettier:format && pnpm run eslint:format
scripts.eslint:changed: FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR --relative HEAD -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mts' '*.js' '*.cjs' '*.mjs'; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mts' '*.js' '*.cjs' '*.mjs'); if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then echo 'No changed files to lint.'; else ESLINT_PROGRESS_LABEL=linting node ./tooling/eslint-config-web/eslint-progress.mjs --fix --cache --cache-strategy content --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern $FILES; fi
scripts.prisma:generate: pnpm run node:validate && prisma generate && pnpm run prisma:patch
scripts.prisma:push: pnpm run node:validate && prisma db push && pnpm run prisma:patch
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- prisma migrate dev && pnpm run prisma:patch
scripts.prisma:migrate:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- prisma migrate dev && pnpm run prisma:patch
scripts.prisma:migrate:create: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- prisma migrate dev --create-only
scripts.prisma:migrate:reset: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- prisma migrate reset && pnpm run prisma:patch
scripts.prisma:migrate:reset:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- prisma migrate reset && pnpm run prisma:patch
scripts.prisma:seed: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:seed:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- prisma db seed
scripts.fixtures:jsonify:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/jsonify/index.ts --live=true && pnpm run fixtures:format
scripts.company:logo: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/update-company-logo.ts
scripts.company:logo:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/update-company-logo.ts
scripts.repositories:sync: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/sync-repositories.ts
scripts.repositories:sync:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/sync-repositories.ts
scripts.experience:calculate: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:dev -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/calculate-experience.ts
scripts.experience:calculate:prod: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm run env:setup:prod -- pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/calculate-experience.ts
scripts.resume:generate: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/generate-resume/index.ts
scripts.resume:fixtures: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/emit-resume-fixtures.ts && pnpm run resume:fixtures:format
scripts.projects:transcode-gifs: pnpm run node:validate && pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/transcode-project-gifs.ts
